talents.name: Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield
talents.desc:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 **Impact Momentum**, he will consume all **Impact Momentum** to instead perform the special Charged Attack **Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment**.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
[Details title="Impact Momentum"]A special energy Valeriy uses to enhance his combat capabilities. Its initial maximum is 100. When he has at least 40 **Impact Momentum**, he can perform the special Charged Attack **Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment**.
Valeriy can gain **Impact Momentum** in the following ways:
·By using his Elemental Skill **Active Defense: Bastion Charge**;
·After unlocking the Ascension Talent "Advance With the Creeping Barrage," while his Elemental Burst **Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo** is active, when a nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an **Electro** attack.[/Details]
[Details title="Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment"]Valeriy's special Charged Attack. Using a Charged Attack while he has at least 40 **Impact Momentum** consumes all **Impact Momentum** to unleash this special Charged Attack instead, dealing **AoE Electro DMG** in front of him and granting 15 stacks of **Offensive Directive**.
When this special Charged Attack is used again, the **Offensive Directive** stack count will be refreshed.
Within 0.8s after using the Elemental Skill **Active Defense: Bastion Charge** or the Elemental Burst **Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo**, if Valeriy has at least 40 **Impact Momentum**, the next Normal Attack he uses will be converted to the special Charged Attack **Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment**.[/Details]
[Details title="Offensive Directive"]A special effect Valeriy gains after performing the special Charged Attack **Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment**. It increases different types of **Electro DMG** depending on whether Valeriy is in the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state. If Valeriy is:
·In the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state: When a nearby active character in the party deals **Electro DMG** considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG to an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of **Offensive Directive** is consumed to increase that DMG, with the increase based on Valeriy's ATK;
·Not in the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state: When a nearby active character in the party deals **Electro DMG** to an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of **Offensive Directive** is consumed to increase that DMG, with the increase based on Valeriy's ATK.
When a single instance of **Electro DMG** hits multiple opponents simultaneously, **Offensive Directive** stacks are consumed based on the number of opponents hit.[/Details]

The Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against ****Electro DMG****.

ult.desc: Deals **AoE Electro DMG** to nearby opponents and fires a **Thunderburst Shell** high into the air. The **Thunderburst Shell** disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing **AoE Electro DMG** to nearby opponents.

passive.desc:
Valeriy enters the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state while within a **Polestar Field**.
[Details title="Polestar Field"]When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a **Polestar Field** for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state, which grants various skill buffs.[/Details]

passive.desc: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.
